title: ERP Board Go-Live Decision With Codex LLM Extraction
decision_request: Decide whether to approve ERP go-live, defer go-live, or approve only with conditions.
context: ERP steering committee says go-live is still targeted for 30 September.
Testing has not started because the test environment is late.
The same two architects support ERP, IAM remediation and CRM rollout.
Sponsor wants to avoid another board escalation.
R-17: ERP test readiness, Red, owner PMO, mitigation not approved.
R-22: Privileged access remediation dependency, Amber, owner CISO office.
R-31: Change-control audit evidence incomplete, Amber, owner IT controls.
Cloud migration spend is 18% above forecast.
No additional architecture capacity is funded.

facts: Testing has not started because the test environment is late.
Cloud migration spend is 18% above forecast.
inferences: Testing compression increases go-live and audit risk.
Shared architecture capacity can create cross-program delivery contention.
assumptions: The 30 September go-live target remains management's preferred date.
Sponsor reluctance may reduce willingness to escalate risk.
hypotheses: Optimistic date language may conflict with operational readiness evidence.
narratives: Go-live remains targeted despite readiness gaps.
contradictions: Target date confidence conflicts with late testing and incomplete audit evidence.
missing_evidence: Approved test plan and defect thresholds.
